title: ArcPulse
tagline: ArcPulse: Unified liquidity on Circle Arc for instant, multi-chain AI and business payouts.
description:
The Problem In the current Web3 landscape, liquidity is trapped in silos. Businesses must maintain separate "inventory" balances on every chain they support—Base, Solana, Avalanche, etc. This leads to massive capital inefficiency and "Ghost Inventory" that sits idle, while traditional bridging methods take up to 20 minutes to finalize, stalling real-world commerce.

The Solution: ArcPulse ArcPulse transforms Circle Arc into the "Economic OS" of the world. By using Arc as a central liquidity hub, we decouple the source of funds from the destination of payment.

How it Works:

Unified Hub: Users deposit USDC into the Arc L1, creating a single "Cloud Balance."

Instant Intent: Our system uses Circle Gateway to authorize cross-chain minting in under 500ms.

Atomic Settlement: Instead of waiting for slow bridges, ArcPulse burns the balance on Arc and instantly triggers a native USDC mint on the destination chain.

Key Technical Innovations:

Zero-Latency Settlement: A 2,400x speed improvement over traditional CCTP finality.

Agentic Autonomy: Integration of x402 and EIP-8004 allows AI agents to autonomously manage payouts and settle services with verified on-chain reputations.

Gas Abstraction: Recipients receive native USDC without needing the destination chain's gas token, thanks to Circle Paymaster integration.

ArcPulse isn't just a bridge; it’s a global delivery system for value, ensuring that your capital is always working, never waiting.
how_its_made:
ArcPulse is a full-stack application leveraging Circle's native infrastructure to bypass traditional bridging bottlenecks:

Circle Arc L1: Acts as the native settlement layer and the "unified balance hub" for all user capital.

Circle Programmable Wallets: Used for session-based, non-custodial treasury management and seamless user onboarding.

Circle Gateway: The core cross-chain Intent API used to coordinate atomic burn-and-mint cycles between Arc and destination chains (e.g., Base, Arbitrum).

x402 Protocol & EIP-8004: Implemented to facilitate machine-to-machine payments, allowing AI agents to settle invoices autonomously.

Frontend/Backend: Built with Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide Icons, hosted on Vercel for high-performance delivery.
